member.name: F:Microsoft.Windows.AI.Text.LanguageModelResponseStatus.PromptLargerThanContext
member.summary: Prompt is larger than the context window and cannot be used to generate a response. Trim prompt with GetUseablePromptLength (or destroy and create a new context). A context window acts like the model's short-term memory, holding the input prompt and the preceding conversation to maintain coherence. A larger context window enables more detailed conversations and processes larger documents but increases processing time, cost, and potentially reduces accuracy.
